[id 62]
Annual pension after 40 years = $50,000
Additional pension after 20 years = 5% of $50,000 = $2,500 per year
Marcy quits after 30 years, so she gets the additional pension for 10 years.
Total annual pension = $50,000 + $2,500 = $52,500

[id 63]
First half of the year (6 months): $140/month * 6 = $840
Second half of the year (6 months): 10% less than $140 = $126/month * 6 = $756
Total amount paid = $840 + $756 = $1596

[id 64]
100 miles traveled with 4 gallons of gas used to fill the tank.
Total tank capacity = 12 gallons
Miles per gallon = 100 miles / 4 gallons = 25 miles/gallon
Miles on a full tank = 25 miles/gallon * 12 gallons = 300 miles

[id 65]
Time spent watching TV per session = 2 hours
Time spent reading per session = 2 hours / 2 = 1 hour
Total time per session = 2 + 1 = 3 hours
Sessions per week = 3
Total time per week = 3 hours/session * 3 sessions = 9 hours
Total time in 4 weeks = 9 hours/week * 4 weeks = 36 hours

[id 66]
Each school has:
- Girls' team: 5 players
- Boys' team: 5 players
- 2 coaches (one for each team)
Total per school = 5 + 5 + 2 = 12 people
Total for 4 schools = 12 people/school * 4 schools = 48 people

[id 67]

Emeralds = 2 * Rubies = 2 * 140 = 280
Total gems = Diamonds + Rubies + Emeralds = 175 + 140 + 280 = 595

[id 68]

Total students = 60 + 120 = 180
Number of teachers = Total students / 5 = 180 / 5 = 36

[id 69]

Initial amount = Total money - Total allowance = $100 - $40 = $60
